description: This file implements the DefaultMessageMapperRegistry class which manages and retrieves MessageMapper instances based on provided mappings, including default, custom, and fallback mappers. It handles validation and resolution logic for message mappers in a communication framework.

classes.name: DefaultMessageMapperRegistry
classes.description: A registry class for managing message mappers with support for default, custom, and fallback strategies.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of DefaultMessageMapperRegistry with specified mappers.

methods.name: getMappers
methods.description: Retrieves a list of MessageMappers based on the given PayloadMapping, resolving each mapper ID.

methods.name: resolveMessageMapper
methods.description: Resolves a mapper ID to a MessageMapper instance, prioritizing custom, then fallback, then default mappers.

methods.name: validatePayloadMapping
methods.description: Validates all mapper references within a PayloadMapping, throwing an exception if any cannot be resolved.

methods.name: validateMessageMapper
methods.description: Validates that a specific mapper ID can be resolved, throwing an exception if not.
